acceptance_criteria: A scheduled and manually dispatchable audit checks the resolved runtime dependency set.
The audit fails on a known vulnerability and uses read-only repository permissions.
Operator documentation explains its scope and limitations.

adoption_impact.note: Improves trust but is not a direct acquisition channel.

confidence.note: The missing recurring control is explicitly recorded in the operator backlog.

dependency_value.note: Restores continuous visibility while repository alerts are disabled.

effort.note: One workflow, focused tests, and documentation are expected.

items.objective: Add a recurring dependency audit for vulnerable versions resolved from main.

reversibility.note: The isolated workflow is easy to disable through a reviewed change.

revenue_impact.note: Security confidence may support pilots, but no revenue effect is verified.

risk.note: Read-only scanning has low regression risk.

urgency.note: Dependabot alerts are unavailable, leaving a known visibility gap.

acceptance_criteria: The owner explicitly enables Dependabot vulnerability alerts in repository settings.
The alerts endpoint becomes readable without weakening another security control.

adoption_impact.note: Security posture may affect evaluator trust.

confidence.note: The alerts endpoint reports that Dependabot alerts are disabled.

dependency_value.note: Enables native vulnerability visibility and security updates.

effort.note: The owner setting is small but cannot be changed by dry-run Autopilot.

items.objective: Enable Dependabot vulnerability alerts through an explicit owner action.

reversibility.note: The setting is reversible by the owner.

revenue_impact.note: No direct revenue effect is verified.

risk.note: Enabling a security control is low product risk but owner-governed.

urgency.note: A security visibility control is currently disabled.

acceptance_criteria: Release status documents match the public repository and v0.2.0 prerelease.
No PyPI or Marketplace availability claim is added without direct verification.

adoption_impact.note: Accurate onboarding and release claims reduce evaluator confusion.

confidence.note: Tracked documents and GitHub release state conflict.

dependency_value.note: Accurate release truth is a prerequisite for distribution work.

effort.note: The work is documentation-only with verification.

items.objective: Reconcile release documentation with the public v0.2.0 prerelease state.

revenue_impact.note: Clear distribution claims may help adoption, with no verified revenue effect.

risk.note: Risk is limited to inaccurate wording.

acceptance_criteria: The five-tester experiment records only consented, observed outcomes.
No outreach is sent and no customer claim is made without owner authorization.
Activation, defects found, repeat use, and paid intent remain distinct metrics.

adoption_impact.note: External validation could reveal onboarding barriers.

confidence.note: The experiment is defined but no outcome has been supplied.

dependency_value.note: Evidence gates determine whether hosted product work is justified.

effort.note: Recruitment and observation require human coordination.

items.objective: Prepare the existing five-tester onboarding experiment without sending outreach.

reversibility.note: A dry-run experiment plan can be revised before contact.

revenue_impact.note: Paid-intent evidence could inform pilots, but none exists yet.

risk.note: Privacy and outreach risk remain until an owner approves execution.
